humain_primitif.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A dense primordial jungle seen from within, massive ancient trees with roots thicker than a man framing the composition. Warm dappled sunlight filters through the canopy in golden shafts. In the center foreground, a male human from a jungle tribe stands in a low ready stance, lean and wiry, his dark hair adorned with feathers and bone beads. Ritualistic geometric body paint in white ochre marks his shoulders and face. His alert amber-brown eyes scan through the foliage with a predator's focus. He wears minimal bone and leather tribal gear, a handmade blowgun held loosely at his side. Behind him, bone totems and feathered spirit-catchers hang from low branches, and a stone altar covered in white clay symbols sits at the base of a colossal tree. The jungle floor is alive with ferns, creeping vines, and bioluminescent fungi in the deepest shadows. The color palette is deep forest green, warm ochre, and golden light against consuming jungle shadow. The mood is sacred, watchful, and alive.

humain_barbare.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A windswept mountain pass at dusk, jagged dark peaks rising against a bruised violet and orange sky. In the center foreground, a female human barbarian of northern origin stands facing the wind, athletic and powerful, her auburn hair falling in war braids decorated with iron rings. Geometric runic tattoos mark her collarbone and forearms. Her pale grey eyes carry the hardness of someone who has survived every winter. She wears fur-lined leather armor with iron shoulder guards, practical and battle-worn, a round shield strapped to her back. Behind her, a massive stone cairn covered in runic carvings glows faintly amber. Heavy iron weapons are driven blade-first into the frozen earth around it. Tattered war banners in deep red and iron grey snap in the fierce wind. Snow particles drift across the frame. The color palette is cold steel blue, iron grey, and deep red against a burning dusk sky. The mood is fierce, ancestral, and unyielding.

humain_civilise.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A grand city seen from a high balcony at golden hour, domed towers and cathedral spires stretching to the horizon. In the center foreground, a male human merchant leans against an ornate stone balustrade, confident and composed. His dark hair is neatly combed back, and his sharp brown eyes carry the calculating warmth of someone who trick people for a living. He wears a richly embroidered doublet in deep burgundy and gold over a clean linen shirt, a guild medallion at his collar, one hand resting on an open ledger beside a half-empty wine glass. Below, a busy market square is visible with merchant stalls, colored awnings, and the distant gleam of a river crossed by an arched bridge. Banners of merchant guilds in burgundy, gold, and deep blue hang from the buildings. The color palette is warm amber, gold, burgundy, and cream against a golden sky. The mood is prosperous, cultured, and quietly powerful.

nain.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. The interior of a colossal dwarven forge hall carved deep inside a mountain. Massive stone pillars engraved with geometric runes rise toward a vaulted ceiling lost in shadow. In the center foreground, a female dwarf stands before the great forge, short and extraordinarily broad-shouldered, her thick auburn hair pulled back in elaborate braids decorated with copper clasps. Her amber eyes glow with reflected forge-fire, steady and proud. Soot marks her cheeks and powerful forearms. She wears a heavy leather apron over engraved plate armor, one hand resting on the head of a freshly forged warhammer still radiating heat. Behind her, the forge burns intense amber-orange, molten metal rivers flow through carved stone channels in the floor. Sparks drift upward like fireflies. The color palette is deep forge amber, bronze, copper, and steel blue against consuming mountain darkness. The mood is ancient, industrious, and mighty.

halfelin.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A cozy caravan camp at twilight along a winding forest road. Three round-topped wooden wagons with painted shutters and hanging lanterns form a half-circle around a crackling campfire. In the center foreground, a male halfling sits cross-legged on a wagon step, small and round with an air of cheerful confidence. His curly chestnut hair is tousled, and his large bright hazel eyes sparkle with mischief in the firelight. His broad bare feet are calloused and comfortable. He wears practical travelling clothes in warm earth tones, pockets everywhere, and holds a deck of worn playing cards mid-shuffle with nimble fingers. Behind him, cooking pots hang over the fire, a clothesline with patchwork quilts stretches between wagons, and open crates of traded goods are scattered about. Fireflies drift in the grass. The color palette is warm honey, cream, chestnut brown, and soft orange firelight against cool blue twilight. The mood is intimate, resourceful, and deceptively comfortable.

elfe.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. An ancient elven sanctum deep within a primordial forest, colossal silver-barked trees rising like cathedral pillars. In the center foreground, a female elf stands with effortless poise, slender and graceful, her long silver-white hair flowing past her waist. Her long pointed ears extend well above her head, catching faint violet light. Her luminous silver-violet eyes hold centuries of memory and quiet superiority. Her pale skin seems to absorb the ambient light. She wears an organic flowing robe with leaf and vine motifs in silver and deep violet, perfect craftsmanship without a single flaw. One hand is raised, palm open, and pale violet magical energy drifts from her fingers in slow deliberate currents. Behind her, delicate bridges of living wood connect platforms grown from the trees, and a massive crystal formation pulses with cold silver-white light. The color palette is silver, deep violet, moonlight blue, and cold white against endless forest shadow. The mood is beautiful, ancient, and unsettling — perfection built on theft.

semi_elfe.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A rain-slicked city street at night, cobblestones reflecting warm tavern light and cold blue moonlight. In the center foreground, a male half-elf walks with deliberate anonymity, his hood pulled low but not quite concealing slightly pointed ears shorter than a full elf's. His features are fine and angular, softened by human warmth, and his vivid green eyes are watchful and guarded beneath the hood. He wears a muted grey-brown travelling cloak over practical dark clothing, everything chosen to avoid attention. One hand holds the cloak closed, the other rests near a concealed blade. Behind him, a torn anti-elven proclamation is partially covered by newer posters on the alley wall. A single candle burns in a window above — a discreet signal. Puddles catch fragments of both warm and cold light. The color palette is muted grey-brown, cold blue moonlight, and isolated pockets of warm amber against deep wet shadow. The mood is liminal, guarded, and quietly resilient.

vulpin.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A moonlit clearing in an ancient forest where blue-white foxfire spirits drift lazily between dark tree trunks. In the center foreground, a female vulpin sits elegantly on a gnarled root, the most refined and human-like of all therians, her delicate features luminous in the foxfire glow. She has graceful fox ears rising from her crown and a single magnificent fluffy fox tail — the only tail — that fills the space beside her, rich flame-orange with a white-cream tip. Her vivid red-orange hair flows loose past her shoulders. Her luminous golden amber eyes hold depths of ancient amusement. She wears a flowing dark kimono-inspired robe with copper thread embroidery, one hand resting on an open calligraphy scroll on a low stone table beside a jade tea set. Paper lanterns in warm amber hang from branches above. Silk ribbons in deep red flutter in a faint breeze. The color palette is warm russet-gold and amber against cold blue-white foxfire and deep forest black. The mood is elegant, knowing, and otherworldly.

felin.positive: A male character with a human face, sharp angular features, vertical slit pupils in luminous golden-amber eyes, and mobile black cat ears atop his head. A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. He has a sinewy and tense build, made for explosive movement. A long prehensile black tail curls behind him for balance. He wears close-fitting dark leather armor, silent and practical, with retractile claws extended on one hand. He crouches on the edge of a rooftop balanced with effortless predatory grace, scanning the streets far below. A moonlit rooftop vista across a dark city at night, slate tiles and chimneys creating a jagged silhouette against a pale full moon. Claw marks are scratched into the stone — territorial markers. Deep shadows pool between the rooftops. The color palette is deep midnight blue, slate grey, and cold silver moonlight with faint amber from distant windows. The mood is solitary, predatory, and sovereign.

canin.positive: A female character with a human face, strong determined features, intense amber eyes, and pointed mobile wolf ears at her crown. A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. She has an athletic and powerful build, shaped for endurance. A bushy wolf tail hangs low and alert behind her. She wears practical leather armor reinforced at the shoulders, a long spear held upright at her side like a sentinel's staff. She stands at the entrance of a fortified camp at the edge of a vast dark forest, a massive bonfire roaring behind her sending sparks into a starry night sky. Heavy wooden shields bearing pack emblems lean against log benches around the fire. A rack of well-maintained weapons stands ready. Watch torches burn along the palisade. Beyond the firelight, the forest is consuming darkness. The color palette is warm bonfire orange, deep brown, and amber against cold starlit darkness. The mood is communal, vigilant, and fiercely protective.

vif.positive: A male character with a youthful human face, alert features, large bright amber eyes, and long expressive rabbit ears rising tall above his head. A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. He has a light and tensed build, wiry muscle under little mass. He wears minimal leather armor that allows full freedom of movement, and his powerful hind legs are bare and calloused. He perches on a platform edge in a light forward-leaning stance, ready to leap at any moment. A hidden settlement built into the canopy of a dense forest, light wooden platforms and rope bridges connecting hollow-trunk shelters between the trees. Warning chimes made of bone and shell hang at the perimeter. Shafts of soft morning light pierce the canopy, illuminating floating pollen. Every platform has multiple escape routes, every bridge can be cut. The color palette is soft green, pale cream, warm brown, and golden morning light against deep forest shadow. The mood is alert, ingenious, and deceptively fragile.

urside.positive: A female character with a human face, broad strong features, a warm expression, soft hazel eyes, and round bear ears atop her head. A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. She is towering and extraordinarily broad-shouldered, the most imposing build imaginable. She wears heavy layered furs and leather, more for tradition than need — her body is its own armor. One large clawed hand rests on a stone doorframe. She stands in the gateway of a massive stone bastion built into a mountain cliff at sunset, the colossal gate open with warm amber firelight spilling onto a broad stone courtyard. A central fire pit large enough to roast an entire beast burns in the courtyard, heavy stone benches arranged around it. Massive iron chains hang as decorative arches above. The mountain is snow-capped above the bastion. The color palette is deep brown, warm amber, honey-gold, and heavy stone grey against a sunset sky of orange and deep purple. The mood is immovable, welcoming, and ancient.

rapace.positive: A male character with a human face, sharp intense features, piercing amber-gold eyes, and brown-gold feathered hair. A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. He has a light and aerodynamic build, made for the sky. Magnificent brown-gold plumage covers his arms and shoulders, and his hands end in retractable talon-claws. He wears minimal leather armor that leaves his plumage free, wind whipping through his hair. He stands on a narrow stone perch jutting out over the void at the top of a sheer cliff face at dawn, arms slightly spread, an endless landscape of forests and mountains painted in soft gold and blue far below. Nesting alcoves carved into the cliff wall are lined with feathers, bone wind-chimes hanging at their entrances. Clouds drift far below. Scattered feathers are caught in powerful updrafts. The color palette is dawn gold, sky blue, warm brown, and pale grey against immense depth. The mood is exhilarating, free, and watchful.

dryade.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. The heart of an impossibly ancient forest where the trees form living walls, a source-tree of staggering size dominating the background. In the center foreground, a female dryad stands among the roots, her body a seamless transition from smooth flesh at her face to bark texture at her shoulders and extremities. Living branches grow from her head like antlers, rustling with green and golden leaves. Her eyes have distinctive bark-ring patterns in deep amber-green, ancient and warm. Moss and tiny ferns grow along her forearms and collarbone. One hand touches the source-tree's root, and where her fingers meet the bark, golden sap-light pulses outward. The forest floor around her is carpeted in luminous moss and fungi. Amber sap weeps from the great tree, hardening into jewel-like drops. Scattered beams of warm green-gold light reach through the dense canopy. The color palette is deep emerald green, golden amber, warm brown bark, and luminous gold-green against profound forest shadow. The mood is primordial, sacred, and breathing.

femme_fleur.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. An overgrown hidden garden at twilight, enclosed by crumbling stone walls overtaken by flowering vines. In the center foreground, a female flower-woman stands among the blooms, strikingly beautiful with skin in soft greenish-gold hues and visible petal patterns across her shoulders and collarbones. Her hair incorporates living crimson rose petals and cascading wisteria vines in purple and silver. Luminous sap traces glow faintly along her arms like botanical veins. Her eyes are vivid green with floral depth, serene and inviting with an edge of danger. She wears a living gown of layered petals and leaves that seems to grow from her body. Around her, roses the size of shields bloom in deep crimson, pale luminous lilies glow like moonlight, and exotic orchids shimmer in vivid magenta. Thorned vines crawl across the ground in beautiful but aggressive patterns. Bioluminescence intensifies as the sky darkens. Fireflies and luminous pollen motes fill the air. The color palette is deep crimson, pure white, violet, vivid green, and soft bioluminescent gold against a deepening twilight sky. The mood is intoxicating, beautiful, and subtly dangerous.

reptilien.positive: A male character with a human face, hard angular features, vertical slit pupils in cold amber-gold eyes, fine geometric tattoo-like markings in dark teal along his collarbones and shoulders. A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A row of short rigid spines runs along the back of his skull and down his neck — purely dorsal. His skin tone is warm olive-bronze, otherwise fully human. A long powerful muscular tail rests behind him. He wears minimal leather armor, a curved bone blade at his hip. He stands perfectly motionless on a flat sunning stone in a sun-baked stone ruin half-submerged in a vast marshland at high noon under a merciless white sun. Massive carved stone pillars rise from dark water, their surfaces covered in precise geometric carvings worn smooth by centuries. A single enormous stone idol watches from the far end. The water is dark, still, and reflective. Heat haze distorts the air. The color palette is harsh sand gold, dark teal, deep green, and sun-bleached bone white against consuming black water. The mood is ancient, patient, and utterly still.

elementaire_de_terre.positive: A dark fantasy anime panoramic banner illustration in shonen manga style, ultra-wide horizontal format. A vast underground cavern of impossible scale, massive crystal formations growing from the walls in cathedral-like clusters. In the center foreground, a female earth elemental stands on a raised plateau of layered sedimentary rock, her massive humanoid form composed of living granite, basalt, and compacted earth. She towers at over two meters, her weight seemingly enough to crack the ground beneath her. Fissures across her stone body reveal a deep amber-orange inner glow like magma flowing beneath the surface. Her eyes are set gemstones — deep amethyst — that glow with patient inner light. Geological layers and mineral veins are visible across her form like the strata of the earth itself. Moss and tiny crystal growths cling to her oldest surfaces. Behind her, quartz, amethyst, and amber topaz formations cast prismatic light. Fissures in the cavern floor glow with magma far below. Stalactites hang like frozen rain above. The color palette is deep stone grey, crystal violet, amber-orange inner glow, and dark earth brown against profound underground darkness. The mood is geological, eternal, and profoundly patient.
